markdown_report:
The best next experiment remains a controlled increase in endpoint supervision within each category’s single BERT4Rec model. At 10% research progress, this small objective change is more informative than architectural expansion; no validation improvement is established. First establish whether the corrected baseline permits a nonredundant weight-only comparison.

**Insights from the starting point.** (1) Appended-mask inference has no right context, whereas interior reconstruction can use future interactions. Endpoint weighting tests a training–inference alignment hypothesis; it does not establish that context mismatch causes poor ranking. (2) Equal group weights can reproduce an existing objective. Record the baseline’s exact reduction, group counts and realized target counts before spending training budget. (3) Electronics has a 13.6% diagnostic wrong-ranking rate and negative lower-tail margin. These training measurements identify a weakness without explaining its cause or establishing validation performance; they do not justify category-specific tuning.

**Insights from related work.** (1) BERT4Rec [1] already adds final-item-only examples. Its released generator [5] uses ten ordinary copies plus one endpoint copy per window by default, but token-normalized implementation loss means example proportions differ from loss proportions; ordinary copies can also mask endpoints. (2) DualRec [2] diagnoses past–future context discrepancy, but its architectural results do not establish the benefit of reweighting one encoder. (3) Embedding-collapse research [3] motivates spectrum measurements beyond cosine, while sampling research [4] cautions against substituting diagnostic margins for host HR@10. Objective-matching evidence [6] further motivates preserving the supplied loss exactly.

**Framework and directions.** Three directions separate intervention from measurement:

| Direction | Existing mechanism | Proposed extension | Evidence boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| Supervision | Interior and endpoint masking | Explicit endpoint weight | Host validation determines benefit |
| Context dependence | Bidirectional reconstruction | Matched prefix/interior probe with position control | Dependence is not user preference or causality |
| Representation | Mean embedding cosine | Effective-rank probe | Geometry is not ranking quality |

**Candidate ideas.** Scores are originality/potential/difficulty; higher difficulty means harder implementation.

- **Endpoint weight 0.75 — 2/5/3.** Originality: controlled attribution is useful, but endpoint supervision is established. Potential: a feasible alignment test, but its coefficient is heuristic. Difficulty: two coefficients suffice, but exact baseline accounting is essential.
- **Matched context-gap probe — 4/6/4.** Originality: matched targets and position controls sharpen diagnosis, but context discrepancy is established. Potential: informs later experiments, but cannot itself improve ranking or establish causality. Difficulty: reuses one checkpoint, but careful attention and positional controls are required.
- **Effective-rank diagnostic — 2/4/2.** Originality: complements cosine, but uses an established statistic. Potential: reveals dimensional concentration, but cannot establish a useful intervention. Difficulty: straightforward singular-value computation, but sampling and centering must be specified.

**Selected experiment.** Compare the exact supplied baseline with a predeclared endpoint weight of 0.75 and reconstruction weight of 0.25. Preserve its loss and within-group reduction, sampling, masks, total batch size and updates. Separate endpoint-only copies from ordinary copies by generation provenance, including ordinary copies that mask endpoints. If constructing groups changes the baseline, require a matched-construction control before attributing gains to weighting. Per-example normalization remains a separate ablation; omit an algebraically redundant equal-weight arm.

```text
record baseline loss, reductions, sampling and optimizer construction
replay identical seeded prefixes, groups and masks across arms
replace every supervised input target with reserved MASK
E, R = baseline_within_group_losses(model, batch)
loss = exact_baseline_reduce(E, R) or .75*E + .25*R
backward once; update the single model
```

BERT4Rec’s paper uses sequence-normalized loss, whereas its release globally averages real masked targets [1,5]; neither establishes the host baseline’s implementation. Hold realized examples and supervised targets fixed across arms, rather than claiming equal target counts between groups. Record optimizer steps, targets, endpoint frequency and GPU time. A coefficient change also changes gradient allocation and variance, so improvement would not alone prove the proposed mechanism.

Keep all four categories, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, ≤200 epochs and 200 batches/epoch. Preserve appended-mask inference with at most N−1 observed items, final-nonpadding readout, predictor/checkpoint consistency and diagnostic interfaces. Charge training, controls and diagnostics to 43,200 GPU-seconds; select exclusively by pinned macro validation HR@10. Disclose validation queries and freeze selection before held-out evaluation. Use paired hit intervals only when available; they exclude seed variation and adaptive-search bias. Inspect frequency/history-length strata for shortcuts without changing selection. Titles and interactions cannot establish ownership, compatibility or immediate need.

References: [1] BERT4Rec; [2] DualRec; [3] Guo et al., ICML 2024; [4] sampling reliability, RecSys 2025; [5] released BERT4Rec implementation; [6] Turning Dross Into Gold Loss. Links appear below.

idea.description: Test a predeclared endpoint-supervision weight of 0.75 against the corrected BERT4Rec baseline, retaining one independently trained model per category. Combine endpoint-only and ordinary reconstruction losses in one optimizer update while preserving each group’s original loss reduction. Treat this as a controlled supervision-allocation experiment, rather than a novel masking mechanism.
idea.motivation: Endpoint masking matches the absence of right context at appended-mask inference and is already established in BERT4Rec. The supplied diagnostic shows weaker training separation for Electronics, but does not demonstrate that context mismatch causes that weakness. A controlled weight change tests whether supervision allocation improves the common validation metric without changing the backbone or introducing independent predictors. Early research progress favors this small experiment over architectural expansion; the matched context-gap probe remains a useful budgeted diagnostic.
idea.implementation_notes:
First document the supplied baseline’s precise loss, reduction, group construction, masking policy, optimizer-step construction and endpoint frequency; these are not provided here. Do not substitute the original paper or released implementation for the corrected host baseline. The paper describes averaging masked-target negative log-likelihood within sequences, whereas the released implementation sums real masked-target losses across the batch and divides by their count plus 1e-5. The released generator ordinarily creates D=10 reconstruction copies plus one endpoint-only copy per window; ordinary copies may also mask endpoints. This 1/11 endpoint-example fraction does not establish endpoint loss weight, and overlapping-window construction must not be imported into the host baseline.

Classify groups by generation provenance, not by whether a sampled mask happens to occupy the final position. If the supplied baseline lacks these explicit groups, retain its exact control and add a matched-construction control before attributing differences to weighting. Predeclare this decision before training; reduce the experiment set if the required controls exceed budget. Ensure both groups are nonempty for each candidate update without silently modifying only the candidate’s sampling. Preserve baseline within-group reduction, including denominator constants; per-example normalization is a separately labeled ablation. For a global token mean, reproduce the exact baseline from group loss sums and counts rather than assuming equal group weights. Omit duplicate objectives, including alpha=0.75 if it already reproduces the control.

Use identical seeded prefix draws, group membership and corruption masks across comparison arms, with separate deterministic sampling and model-randomness streams. Keep total examples, realized supervised targets, optimizer steps and evaluation schedule matched across arms. Endpoint and reconstruction groups need not have equal target counts. Record their sizes, targets, terminal-target frequency, retained context length and actual GPU time. Predeclare equal maximum GPU-time allocations as budget caps; compare matched completed updates where feasible and disclose any unequal completion. The coefficient changes gradient allocation and potentially gradient variance, so a gain cannot independently identify context mismatch as its cause.

Endpoint inputs contain a training-prefix target replaced by reserved MASK, clean preceding context, and truncation reserving the target position. Every supervised input target must be MASK, with labels used only in the loss. Ordinary reconstruction retains the corrected baseline’s eligible positions, mask-count rule and nonempty-target policy; do not add endpoint fallback for empty masks. Never expose shifted targets through bidirectional inputs or silently replace the baseline loss with catalog cross-entropy.

Retain DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics and CDs_and_Vinyl routing, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, at most 200 epochs and 200 batches per epoch. Keep execution single-GPU. Charge all comparison training, diagnosis, validation and failures to the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget. Each deployed category loads exactly one independently trained checkpoint; no checkpoint averaging, independent experts or score fusion. Preserve predictor-writer consistency and appended-mask inference: retain at most N-1 observed items, append MASK, left-pad and read its final nonpadding position, never count-1.

Keep ModelView hooks, view.model as the actual module, item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data, review_data, DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Diagnostic batches remain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with B x L tensors. Measure valid supervised MASK positions only; unavailable quantities remain null. Optional matched context probes use public training targets and fixed candidates, comparing right-context-present and prefix-only inputs with a position-preserving attention control. They measure model dependence, not causal preference. Any effective-rank probe must specify embedding sample, centering, singular-value normalization and entropy convention.

Select solely using the unchanged host four-category macro validation HR@10: 200 validation users/category, 99 unique negatives and evaluation seed 42. Do not tune the coefficient specifically to Electronics from training diagnostics. If paired host user hits are available, report candidate-only and baseline-only counts, category delta=(candidate-only-baseline-only)/200, and bootstrap users within categories before equally averaging category deltas. One net hit changes category HR@10 by 0.5 percentage points; intervals exclude training-seed variation and adaptive-search bias. Disclose all validation queries, treat reused-validation gains as exploratory, and freeze the final configuration before held-out evaluation. Inspect frequency/history-length breakdowns for possible popularity shortcuts without changing selection. Do not access hidden test files, other trials, unavailable ratings/reviews/categories/prices/stores or pretrained downloads. Interactions do not prove ownership or immediate need; missing compatibility evidence means unknown. No empirical improvement is claimed.
idea.pseudocode:
spec = document_corrected_baseline_objective_and_sampling()
plan = predeclare_exact_baseline_and_weight_candidate(alpha=0.75)
if explicit_group_construction_changes_baseline(spec):
    plan.require_matched_construction_control()
plan.omit_algebraically_duplicate_arms()
plan.allocate_shared_gpu_budget_including_controls_and_diagnostics()

for arm in plan.arms:
    for category in four_categories:
        model = initialize_corrected_bert4rec(seed=42)
        stream = reset_identical_seeded_sampling_stream(category)
        for epoch in range(at_most_200):
            for step in range(200):
                stop_if_predeclared_allocation_exhausted()
                batch = stream.draw_arm_appropriate_batch(arm)
                assert_supervised_inputs_are_reserved_MASK(batch)
                terms = compute_unchanged_baseline_loss_terms(model, batch)
                if arm == 'exact_baseline':
                    loss = spec.exact_reduce(terms)
                else:
                    E, R = partition_by_generation_provenance(terms)
                    if arm == 'matched_construction_control':
                        loss = spec.exact_reduce(concatenate(E, R))
                    else:
                        assert_nonempty_groups(E, R)
                        loss = 0.75 * spec.reduce_within_group(E) + 0.25 * spec.reduce_within_group(R)
                optimizer.zero_grad()
                loss.backward()
                optimizer.step()
                record_counts_updates_context_and_gpu_time()
        save_one_category_checkpoint_and_matching_predictor(model)

# Compare configurations using the unchanged host macro validation HR@10.
# Freeze the selected configuration before held-out evaluation.
# Each category loads exactly its selected single trained checkpoint.
# Inference: retain latest N-1 observations, append reserved MASK,
# left-pad, encode bidirectionally, and score the final nonpadding position.

originality.positive: Explicit objective accounting and matched controls make supervision allocation interpretable while separating weighting from normalization and sampling.
originality.negative: BERT4Rec already includes endpoint-only supervision, and fixed weighted objectives are established; 0.75 is a heuristic coefficient.

future_potential.positive: A controlled result can establish whether supervision allocation merits later studies of context reliance or training schedules within one encoder.
future_potential.negative: A small benchmark gain may reflect gradient allocation, popularity shortcuts or adaptive validation search rather than the proposed context-mismatch mechanism.

code_difficulty.positive: When explicit groups already exist, the intervention changes loss coefficients while retaining the inference architecture.
code_difficulty.negative: Exact reductions, deterministic group construction and predictor consistency require care; a missing group construction adds controls and compute, and the absent baseline source prevents a drop-in implementation.

related_work.title: BERT4Rec: Sequential Recommendation with Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformer
contributions: Establishes bidirectional masked-item reconstruction and appended-mask next-item inference.
Section 3.6 explicitly includes final-item-only masked examples to align training with prediction.
Equation (8) describes averaging masked-target negative log-likelihood within a sequence; inference reserves a position for MASK.
limitations: Does not specify a numerical mixing coefficient or establish that endpoint weight 0.75 improves this benchmark.
Its masking ablations do not isolate endpoint weighting with matched sampling, target counts and loss normalization.
Interior reconstruction can use right context unavailable at next-item inference.

related_work.title: Disentangling Past-Future Modeling in Sequential Recommendation via Dual Networks
contributions: Identifies discrepancies between past-context prediction and modeling with future context.
Studies separate past/future encoders, directional objectives and knowledge transfer, with only the past encoder used at inference.
limitations: Its architecture is not adopted in this single-BERT4Rec proposal.
Its results do not constitute a controlled terminal/reconstruction-loss weighting experiment within one encoder.
Context reliance does not independently establish a causal explanation for weak next-item ranking.

related_work.title: ICML 2024 study of embedding collapse in recommendation
contributions: Motivates examining low-rank embedding structure beyond average pairwise cosine similarity.
limitations: Embedding geometry alone does not establish recommendation quality or diversity.
The supplied cosine measurements do not demonstrate low-rank collapse.

related_work.title: RecSys 2025 study of sampling reliability in recommendation evaluation
contributions: Examines reliability of sampled recommendation evaluation and its agreement with fuller evaluation settings.
limitations: Does not justify changing the pinned host evaluator.
Single-negative training margins remain distinct from the benchmark’s 100-candidate HR@10.

related_work.title: Released BERT4Rec implementation: generator, loss and evaluation construction
contributions: gen_data_fin.py generates ordinary masked copies and an additional final-item-only copy per training window; the default/script duplication factor is ten.
Ordinary masking chooses a bounded, nonempty number of targets, and mask_prob=1.0 replaces selected items with MASK.
run.py globally normalizes loss by real masked-target count plus 1e-5, distinguishing example frequency from objective weight.
Evaluation retains at most N-1 observed items plus a masked held-out target; released scripts can use overlapping training windows.
limitations: The released construction does not establish the corrected host baseline’s sampling or loss.
A 1/11 endpoint-example fraction does not imply 1/11 endpoint-loss weight.
Importing its windows, masking rates or reductions would introduce additional experimental changes.

related_work.title: Turning Dross Into Gold Loss
contributions: Shows that matching training objectives substantially changes SASRec–BERT4Rec comparisons, motivating careful loss accounting.
limitations: Does not establish a particular endpoint-supervision coefficient or its benefit on the pinned benchmark.
Does not justify changing model family or replacing the corrected baseline’s objective during a weight-only experiment.
